            # Verify the actual blocks without fitting another network or
            # changing parameters. Length 67 exercises both clipping limits.
            model.eval()
            probe_length = 67
            probe_x = torch.randn(3, probe_length, model.hidden, device=device)
            probe_active = torch.zeros(
                3, probe_length, 1, dtype=torch.bool, device=device
            )
            probe_active[0, -2:] = True
            probe_active[1, -1:] = True
            probe_allowed = probe_active.squeeze(-1)[:, None, None, :]
            perturbed_x = torch.where(
                probe_active, probe_x, torch.randn_like(probe_x) * 100.0
            )
            state = model.state_dict()
            for index, block in enumerate(model.blocks):
                key = f"blocks.{index}.relative_bias"
                assert key in state
                assert state[key].shape == (block.heads, 65)
                assert torch.count_nonzero(block.relative_bias).item() == 0
                indices = block._relative_indices(probe_length, device)
                positions = torch.arange(probe_length, device=device)
                expected_indices = (
                    positions[:, None] - positions[None, :]
                ).clamp(-32, 32) + 32
                assert torch.equal(indices, expected_indices)
                assert indices[4, 3].item() == 33
                assert indices[3, 4].item() == 31
                assert indices[0, -1].item() == 0
                assert indices[-1, 0].item() == 64
                assert indices.diagonal().eq(32).all().item()

                with torch.no_grad():
                    # Reconstruct the previous Boolean-mask attention path.
                    qkv = block.qkv(block.norm1(probe_x)).reshape(
                        3, probe_length, 3, block.heads,
                        model.hidden // block.heads,
                    )
                    q, k, v = qkv.permute(2, 0, 3, 1, 4).unbind(0)
                    has_allowed = probe_allowed.any(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
                    dummy_key = positions.eq(0)
                    safe_allowed = probe_allowed | (~has_allowed & dummy_key)
                    context = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(
                        q, k, v, attn_mask=safe_allowed, dropout_p=0.0
                    ).masked_fill(~has_allowed, 0.0)
                    context = context.transpose(1, 2).reshape(
                        3, probe_length, model.hidden
                    )
                    expected = probe_x + block.residual_dropout(
                        block.projection(context)
                    )
                    expected = (
                        expected + block.ffn(block.norm2(expected))
                    ) * probe_active
                    actual = block(probe_x, probe_allowed, probe_active)
                    assert torch.isfinite(actual).all().item()
                    torch.testing.assert_close(
                        actual, expected, rtol=3e-4, atol=3e-5
                    )
                    # Changing excluded keys must not change visible outputs.
                    perturbed = block(
                        perturbed_x, probe_allowed, probe_active
                    )
                    torch.testing.assert_close(
                        actual, perturbed, rtol=3e-4, atol=3e-5
                    )
                    assert actual[~probe_active.expand_as(actual)].eq(0).all().item()

                probe = block(probe_x, probe_allowed, probe_active)
                (probe * torch.randn_like(probe)).sum().backward()
                gradient = block.relative_bias.grad
                assert gradient is not None
                assert torch.isfinite(gradient).all().item()
                assert gradient.abs().sum().item() > 0
                assert all(
                    torch.isfinite(parameter.grad).all().item()
                    for parameter in block.parameters()
                    if parameter.grad is not None
                )

            # Strict checkpoint compatibility includes every relative table.
            model.load_state_dict(state, strict=True)
            model.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
